_help: The approved bullet bank. Tailoring may choose, order and lightly reword these bullets; it can never add facts. 'master': true marks the default set. 'group' marks bullets that share a metric: at most one per group. Job keys must match the 'id' of each job in master.json. forbidden_phrases are regexes that must never appear.

bullets.text: Led **25+ mixed-methods studies** (interviews, usability tests, surveys) across mobile banking and lending products.
Redesigned account onboarding from research findings, **raising completed sign-ups by 9%**.
Built a **research repository and intake process** used by four product teams.
Partnered with **Product, Design and Engineering leads** to turn insights into roadmap decisions.
Mentored **three junior researchers** on study design and synthesis.
Ran **card sorts and tree tests** to simplify navigation in the mobile app.
Conducted **generative research with clinicians and patients** to shape a telehealth scheduling product.
Ran **moderated usability testing** on patient-portal flows and prioritized fixes with the product team.
Synthesized findings into **journey maps and personas** adopted across the design team.
Designed and analyzed **surveys of 1,200 patients** to size unmet needs.
Supported **field studies and interviews** for a retail client's in-store app.
Created **affinity maps and research readouts** for client stakeholders.
